scripts.docker-install: docker compose exec atlas sh -c 'npm install && cd api && npm install && cd ../vite && npm install'
scripts.docker-setup: npm run make-cert && npm run make-hosts
scripts.run-migrations: cd api && export $(grep -v '^#' ../.env.api | xargs) && PGHOST=localhost npx typeorm-ts-node-commonjs migration:run -d ./src/data-source.ts
scripts.make-hosts: echo 'chocolate.local resolves via mDNS — no hosts entry needed'
scripts.repl: cd api && PGHOST=localhost OLLAMA_HOST=localhost REDIS_HOST=localhost npm run repl
